messages:
samir: Quick status check on the Evergrain private rollout — need a concise owners/deps list for networking + airgap blockers. Who's got final sign-off on firewall rules and egress strategy?
elaine: NetOps is owning the firewall rule set. PR submitted: https://git.internal/netops/firewalls/pulls/342 — waiting on Evergrain IP allowlist to merge.
evergrain-sre: We sent the allowlist to elaine yesterday (csv+fingerprint). Can re-share if needed.
samir: Can you paste the IP block snippet here? want to smoke test once merged.
elaine: pasted below, moto quick example:
```
# evergrain ip allowlist sample
10.111.0.0/22
198.51.100.128/25
203.0.113.10
```
josiah: Heads-up on cert rotation — the private deployment is airgapped except for a management jumpbox. Options we discussed:
  1) Bring ACME-signed certs via secure USB (customer approved)
  2) Use the jumpbox to perform on-behalf issuance (requires temporary egress)
Which does Evergrain prefer?
evergrain-sre: We'll use the jumpbox broker approach. They already provided the trust anchor fingerprint.
maria: OK I'll push the trust anchor into the secrets-store (vault path: secret/private/evergrain/trust-anchor) and annotate the deploy.
infra-bot: canary/deploy to staging-private/us-west-2 completed — 12/12 checks OK :white_check_mark:
netops: Firewall rule merged to staging; production merge gated on SNI passthrough validation from eng-runtime. There is also an egress-proxy SNI header we need to confirm: `X-Forwarded-Host` vs `Host`.
samir: Assigning eng-runtime to validate SNI behavior and proxy headers. @anna can you run the proxy + SNI smoke and confirm header passthrough and keep-alive behaviour? also verify KV cache reload after warm restart — that was a flaky spot in the last cutover.
anna: (typo) -- meant @anna.
anna: :eyes: i mean anna :)
anna: Got it — will run tests tomorrow 08:00 PT. Test plan: 1) curl through proxy with SNI override; 2) simulate warm restart and check KV cache persisted state; 3) run 50 concurrent token-generating requests to validate latency tail. Test commands I'll use below.
```bash
# SNI test
curl -v --resolve api.evergrain.internal:443:10.111.0.5 https://api.evergrain.internal/health -H 'Host: api.evergrain.internal'
# warm restart smoke (offline restart)
kubectl rollout restart deploy/evergrain-inference -n private && watch kubectl logs -f deployment/evergrain-inference -n private | grep "restore-kv"
```
josiah: FYI if the jumpbox path needs a temporary NAT rule we should have a rollback window and manual approval flow documented. I'll open a small RFC in the repo.
maria: noted. I'll also pin a canary window in the console (2 hours) and notify support for standby.
evergrain-sre: For the jumpbox approach, we require an audit of egress events. Can infra add a log-forwarding step?
netops: We can forward jumpbox audit logs to the customer's S3 bucket; need a confirm on retention policy (default 90d).
els: quick ask — any changes to the fallback model policy? last time we had a layered fallback (small model -> quantized -> local cached). Need to lock sequence for consistency testing.
samir: Fallback sequence stays: tiny -> quant -> local-cache -> degrade-response. Please add test vectors to the rollout checklist.
anna: I'll attach PR with test vectors after smoke.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled production merge for firewall rules at 2026-03-18T17:00Z (manual approval required).
josiah: tagging @netops @anna @maria for manual approval and pre-merge smoke.
ellaine: small correction: elaine here — I'll trigger the merge once evergrain-sre confirms allowlist fingerprint match.
evergrain-sre: confirmed fingerprint matches; good to proceed.
samir: awesome — summary of owners: NetOps (firewall/egress) = elaine/netops; Eng-runtime = anna (SNI + KV smoke); Infra = maria (secrets + canary window); Security/audit = evergrain-sre (audit + trust anchor). If anyone disagrees, speak up now. Otherwise we'll call this the final owners list and proceed with the production merge. :thumbsup:
